title: U.S. four-star general warns of war with China in 2025 | Wake Up America
summary: A January 2023 Newsmax segment on a US Air Force general's memo predicting war with China over Taiwan in 2025, plus commentary on Putin's aims and Western tanks for Ukraine.

assertions.quote: my gut tells me we will fight in 2025.

verdicts.note: 2025 passed without a US-China war over Taiwan.
The Metaculus sub-question on a Chinese full-scale invasion of Taiwan before 2026 has resolved No, so the predicted 2025 war over Taiwan did not happen.
UCDP's list of every state-based armed conflict active in 2025 includes no conflict between China and the US or over Taiwan.

assertions.quote: Putin believes it's his Destiny to recreate the Russian Empire

verdicts.note: His speeches stress Russia's historical claims on Ukraine, but his intentions beyond it are a leader's belief no public record can show.

DDIS says the Putin regime sees extensive control over the former Soviet space (Ukraine, Belarus, Moldova, Georgia) as a prerequisite for great-power status: control, not necessarily annexation of an empire.

assertions.quote: what we've essentially done is recreated the battle lines of World War One in a war of attrition

verdicts.note: SIPRI describes Russia's invasion as having 'gradually become a war of attrition', with Russia switching to high volumes of cheaper weapons.
DDIS describes a war of attrition in which Russia is better placed thanks to recruitment and production, with territorial change of only about 1% since 2022.
UCDP: deaths were dominated by combatants every year except 2022, with 102,100 battle deaths in 2024 and 94,700 in 2025, a pattern consistent with attritional war.
